card.name: Drug-class nouns in interaction sections
card.fires_on: Words like products, agents, drugs, and linking words (of, and, almost) in drug interaction text, right before the interacting drug or substance is named. Also appears in missed-dose wording.

modes.label: Class nouns
modes.description: Generic nouns such as products, agents or drugs ending a category phrase in interaction text.
modes.example: Antidiabetic<< agents>> Hypoglycemia including fatal outcomes

modes.label: Linking words
modes.description: Small words like of or and that link a drug to its effect or partner drug.
modes.example: Deferasirox increases the exposure<< of>> repaglinide.

modes.label: Missed dose wording
modes.description: Word almost in the missed-dose instruction.
modes.example: If it is<< almost>> time for the next dose, the missed
